status: ALTERNATIVE NUMERIC WORLD SEMANTICS / SURVEY_ONLY. Not an execution optimization of C1-B1 and not a replacement for it.
semantics: World state = exact real values defined by expressions of the UNROUNDED KDK map (dt = 40, half kick 20, Ar40 mass of C1-B1, frozen C1-A Lang 2024 force with retardation). C1-B1 rounds every step; this does not.
measuring_device: Projection of q onto the FX(96,48) position grid and p onto the FX(96,80) momentum grid (round half even) is a TEST MEASUREMENT only, never fed back into the state.
force_evaluator: exact_expression_gate_v0/lang_iv.py: mpmath interval transcription of the same formula and exact constants as a_reference/ar2_lang2024.py, cross-checked against ar2_lang2024.enclose in the tests. Trust base: mpmath interval arithmetic gives true enclosures.

paths.A: expression DAG with hash-consing (identical sub-expressions shared), no algebra
paths.B: A + verified algebra optimizer at node construction: exact constant folding, x+0, x*1, x*0, x-x, multiplication by a constant as scaling, and linear-combination merging of a child with at most 2 terms (MERGE_MAX_TERMS = 2) with exact rational coefficients. Every rewrite is an exact identity of real numbers. Pre-seal change (disclosed): unbounded flattening was dropped after the quick smoke run showed it copies all past force terms into each new node.
paths.C: replay baseline: initial state + law + step count; interval KDK recomputed from the start
paths.tree: reference only: size of the fully expanded tree computed by counting (never materialised)

scenarios.F_free: 1 atom, no force (closed-form control). q0 = (0,0,0), p0 = (14, 3, -2)
scenarios.A2_bound: N=2 Ar, q = (-71/20,0,0), (71/20,0,0); p = (1,-3,0), (-1,3,0) (relative kinetic 1.4e-4 hartree < well depth): low-dimensional central-force case. Not assumed integrable; sensitivity is measured.

extended_checkpoint: 10000 for a scenario only if its full 1000-step precision sweep took < 300 s wall; otherwise NOT_RUN(time). The extended run measures only the 10000-step checkpoint.
execution: the four scenarios run in parallel processes; each writes its own result file when done

metrics.expression_size: size = nodes + edges reachable from the current state (world state size) for A and B at every checkpoint; total nodes ever created; slope per step. Pre-seal change (disclosed): the size measure was nodes only; the quick smoke run showed B can trade nodes for edges, so edges are included.
metrics.required_precision: smallest grid precision at which every q and p component of the checkpoint state projects to a single grid cell (interval evaluation of path A). Interval blow-up into R^2 < r_min^2 or a non-positive R^2 counts as undecided at that precision. Cap 8192 bits -> UNDECIDED_AT_CAP.
metrics.intrinsic_sensitivity: two point trajectories (prec 400) with q0 x of atom 0 differing by 2^-100: log2(max |delta state| / 2^-100) at checkpoints. Diagnostic of the map, not a certificate.
metrics.cost: wall time of DAG build (A, B), optimizer share, evaluation of the checkpoint at its required precision for A and B, replay C at the same precision; tracemalloc peak of the DAG build
metrics.agreement: A, B and C must project to identical grid cells at every decided checkpoint

hypotheses_sealed_not_results: Reachable node count grows linearly in steps for every interacting scenario; the optimizer reduces only a constant factor there and collapses the free-flight case to O(1).
Required precision grows with step count in A3_high; the resulting total cost may grow roughly like t^2. This is a hypothesis to be tested, not a conclusion.
C (replay) is at least as fast as A/B for a single query; A/B can only win by caching intermediate states.

per_scenario_flags.optimizer_meaningful: B reachable size (nodes + edges) slope <= 0.5 x A slope (computed between checkpoints 100 and the last one run)
per_scenario_flags.precision_wall: any checkpoint UNDECIDED_AT_CAP, or (bits(last) - bits(100)) / (last - 100) > 0.05 bits/step (extrapolates beyond 5e4 bits at 1e6 steps)
per_scenario_flags.expression_wall: B reachable-state bytes slope x 1e6 steps > 1e9 bytes (bytes = tracemalloc peak of the build divided by created (nodes + edges), times reachable (nodes + edges))
per_scenario_flags.replay_dominates: B (build + evaluation at the required precision) wall time >= C wall time at the last checkpoint

overall: PROMISING: in every interacting scenario optimizer_meaningful and no precision_wall, no expression_wall, not replay_dominates
CONDITIONAL: F_free passes (O(1) state under B, precision not growing) and at least one interacting scenario fails; the failing flags are listed
otherwise the dominant failure among PRECISION_WALL / EXPRESSION_WALL / REPLAY_DOMINATES, reported with all flags

no_post_hoc_changes: Scenarios, grids, thresholds and rules are fixed before running.
